name: Tyler Satchel Orden
body:
Statement. Erdős problem #112, the case k(6,3): the least k such that every oriented graph on k vertices has 6 pairwise non-adjacent vertices or a transitive triangle.

What was known. 29 <= k(6,3) (D. Kirtchakov, Zenodo 10.5281/zenodo.21890619, 11 Aug 2026, the circulant on Z_28) and k(6,3) <= 33 (Ihringer, Rajendraprasad and Weinert, n^2 - n + 3).

My result. 30 <= k(6,3) <= 32.

Lower bound: an explicit oriented graph on 29 vertices with no independent 6-set and no transitive triangle (file in the Zenodo record below; all versions DOI), checkable in seconds. Kirtchakov's Z_28 circulant, which gives 29 <= k(6,3), is also in my Zenodo record (found independently and later); his record is earlier and is credited.
Upper bound: a counting argument with one computed lemma (every oriented graph on 14 vertices with no transitive triangle and no independent 4-set has all degrees equal to 6), whose computation takes seconds and is public.
Lean: both bounds are proved in Lean 4 (no sorry, standard axioms only), registered in Palomar as PALOMAR-2026-11-15-000004 and checked there by three kernels (Lean's own, nanoda and con-ron).
